title: MedicalSoapNote
description: Structured extraction for a clinical SOAP note (Subjective/Objective/Assessment/Plan). Used by the RealEstate-Bench desktop app's medical industry pack. See docs/extending-to-other-industries.md §4.2.

chief_complaint.description: Primary reason for the visit, in patient's own words or provider's summary

hpi.description: History of present illness: symptom onset, duration, severity, alleviating/aggravating factors

past_medical_history.description: Relevant past medical history, comma-separated conditions; empty if none

medications.description: Current medications as free text, semicolon-separated; empty if none

allergies.description: Known drug allergies, semicolon-separated; 'NKDA' if none

vital_signs.description: Vitals if recorded (BP, HR, T, RR, SpO2); null if absent

physical_exam.description: Physical exam findings by system; empty if not documented

assessment.description: Provider's diagnostic assessment, one ICD-10-style description per list item, empty list if not stated

plan.description: Treatment plan items: medications prescribed, tests ordered, follow-up timing

follow_up.description: Follow-up instructions, e.g. 'return in 2 weeks'; null if none
